items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: she gave one to Barney Pichards who was president of Local 10 at that time.

ctx.x: -- behind you. There's all that community appreciation.

Right, well, see this has been my life. I've lived in this neighborhood, this community and things. And a lot of them -- and the awards and things, you know? Now, Mahalia Jackson, there, there's one from Mahalia Jackson up here. And that was given to me in appreciation for a concert that she had arranged for Martin Luther King. And we furnished the band for her. I got the band for her, and she -- and then, this was right at the beginning of the integration of the union, so the union gave her -- oh, let's see,…
Well, do you still do a lot of community work?
